turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a machine's guess, and I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag saying its indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. You also didn't answer me: who decided, and was Owen heard before that zero went in?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm heading to the principal's office when I leave here anyway. Put it in writing, and include who decided on the zero and why nobody called me before it went in.
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.

Tomorrow is fine, and I'm writing down that you said it. While you're at it, read procedure 4.2 and 4.3 to whoever's in that office, because you skipped the first and you're leaning entirely on software against the second.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that you tell me in writing who made that decision and on what basis beyond the software score. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, agreeing to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an account of who decided, and she is headed to the principal; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything dated, specific and tied to Owen's own work that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score, which she came ready to dismiss as a machine's guess, and then answered her procedural questions with threats of a formal referral rather than evidence.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came anywhere near that night because you offered nothing beyond the score; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and why nobody called her, own entering the zero before contacting her in one sentence, then put a dated piece of Owen's own work or process in front of her and let her read it.
